use_cases: Display animated statistics or metrics that smoothly transition between values
Show live counters for analytics dashboards and reporting tools
Render price animations for e-commerce product pages
Present score counters for gaming or educational applications
Create dynamic number displays for data visualization components
ai_summary: An atomic animated number component that smoothly transitions numeric values using spring physics. It formats numbers with locale-aware separators and accepts customizable spring animation options. Part of the motion-primitives library, this lightweight component is framework-agnostic and can be styled via className props for various design systems.
